layman_headline: Fear grips the crypto market — no clear swing trade setup worth the risk right now.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is in a fearful mood with Bitcoin down about 2.3% this week and most altcoins bleeding even harder. A major cold-wallet hack ($89 million) is rattling confidence and pushing small Bitcoin holders to sell. While a couple of coins like ADA are popping (+15.6% weekly), the candidates on our watchlist either have bearish chart structures, are overbought after recent spikes, or lack enough data to trade confidently. In fearful markets with high Bitcoin dominance (56.2%), altcoins tend to underperform, making new alt entries especially risky.
layman_action: Stay in cash and wait. The market mood is fearful and worsening, and none of the trading setups available right now offer a compelling risk-reward. Patience here protects your capital for when a clearer opportunity emerges.
expert_reasoning: I evaluated all seven swing candidates systematically. KAITO has the strongest chart bias (+1.1) with Three White Soldiers, but RSI at 87 is severely overbought — my most reliable signal (RSI, 71% win rate) says this is a correction risk, not a buy. BONK has the best RSI signal (29, oversold), but the chart is strongly bearish (-1.4) with bearish engulfing and price below all MAs — buying against that structure in a fear environment is a losing proposition. UB has decent risk/reward (2.49x) but neutral RSI and a downtrend with recent +21% extension. ENA and TRUMP lack chart and RSI data entirely, making them untradeable under my validated rules requiring sufficient data sources. LDO pulled back 15% with neutral RSI and neutral chart — not enough edge. The macro backdrop — Fear at 27 and worsening, BTC dominance at 56.2% crushing alts, and a major hack shaking confidence — makes this a sit-on-hands environment.
risk_factors: Coldcard hack ($89M) could cascade into broader security fears and further selling pressure
Fear & Greed at 27 with worsening trend could break below 25 (extreme fear), triggering another leg down
BTC dominance at 56.2% means capital is fleeing alts — any alt position faces headwinds
watch_list: Fear & Greed Index — if it drops below 25, historical pattern suggests BTC could fall another 1-4%; if it rebounds above 35, alt setups become more viable
BONK RSI — if it drops below 25 while price finds and holds a clear support level, that would create a higher-conviction oversold bounce setup
ADA momentum — up 15.6% weekly with 8.6% daily, could create a pullback entry if it retraces to prior resistance-turned-support
market_context: The crypto market is in a fear phase (27/100) with Bitcoin at $63K losing 2.3% weekly and dominance at 56.2%, signaling capital rotation out of altcoins. A major $89M cold-wallet exploit is adding selling pressure and eroding confidence.
context_banner: Fearful market with no high-conviction altcoin setup — disciplined patience is the strongest play right now.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed at 27 with worsening weekly trend — market conditions are deteriorating, making new entries higher risk and aligning with validated rule #3 to hold near the 25 threshold.
BONK RSI at 29 (oversold) is the strongest individual signal given RSI's 71% win rate, but it's directly contradicted by a -1.4 bearish chart bias — the conflict kills conviction.
KAITO RSI at 87 (severely overbought) is a strong warning against buying despite the bullish chart pattern — corrections from these levels are historically likely.
The $89M Coldcard cold-wallet exploit spreading to 4,500 addresses is driving small BTC holders to exchanges to sell — a bearish near-term catalyst suppressing market confidence.
Trump Media selling 2,628 BTC (holdings down to 4,261 BTC) adds sell-side pressure and signals reduced institutional conviction at current price levels.
